en: A colorized panoramic view over a waterfront town on a hilly shoreline, with many houses and larger buildings along a curved bay or river. The water is in the foreground, green hills with scattered structures are in the background. There is a red Ottoman-era postage stamp (20 paras) in the upper left corner. At the top center is printed text identifying the view, and there are handwritten notes in pen across the sky area and right side. The card has a printed website watermark at the bottom right.
